description: This file defines a shell script function 'preinit_set_mac_address' that sets the MAC addresses of network interfaces based on the board type. It uses various external scripts and functions to retrieve MAC addresses and applies them to specific network devices during pre-initialization.

methods.name: preinit_set_mac_address
methods.description: Sets MAC addresses for different board types during system preinitialization.

calls: ip link set dev eth0 address
ip link set dev eth1 address
